item.title: Go vs Py
item.description: If you’re building something small a prototype, an admin panel, a bot stick with Python. You’ll ship faster. If you’re building something that needs to feel instant a social feed, a real-time dashboard, an API for hundreds of users try Go. You don’t need microservices. You don’t need Kubernetes. You don’t need a team of 10. You just need a binary that sits on a tiny VPS and doesn’t fall over when your friends are online. Go gave me that. Maybe it will give you that too.

item.title: Runtime Over Syntax
item.description: We need runtimes that help humans and LLMs solve problems together. LLMs read code like water flows through paths. Give them clear code and they understand fast. item.title: Delete Second Brain
item.description: Human memory is not an archive. It is associative, embodied, contextual, and emotional. We do not think in folders. We do not retrieve meaning through backlinks. Our minds are improvisational. They forget on purpose.
